{"command":"cd /workspace && python - <<'PY'
import ast
from pathlib import Path
from src.component import count_beautiful_integers
module = ast.parse(Path('tests.py').read_text())
for node in ast.walk(module):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Assert):
        call = node.test.left
        args = tuple(ast.literal_eval(arg) for arg in call.args)
        expected = ast.literal_eval(node.test.comparators[0])
        actual = count_beautiful_integers(*args)
        print(args, f'expected={expected}, actual={actual}', 'PASS' if actual == expected else 'MISMATCH')
PY"}
